Trombla's source-verified allotment is 464 (Citizen Potawatomi); cross-referenced with BLM accession 715720. The other Trombla record (part11_questionnaire_001) was corrected 2026-04-28 by patch_nicholas_trombla.py; these two records were missed in that pass.
